source_state: Frozen modified-working-tree candidate, not a published release.
environment: One managed-cloud Chromium run with a disposable local profile; the main quality-check runner was active concurrently.
scope: Only the 10,000-task workspace run below, not the complete 33-program release suite.

dataset.notes: Synthetic tasks with projects, tags, descriptions and partially completed subtasks.

methodology.timings: Elapsed milliseconds around scripted operations, including browser interaction and driver work; not pure rendering CPU time.
methodology.concurrency: The main quality-check runner was running concurrently. Do not use these timings for a direct speed comparison with 4.6 or a device performance promise.
methodology.memory: Browser heap and process RSS were not measured. Export byte counts describe files, not memory use.
methodology.limits: One cloud run does not establish real-device performance, operating-system notification delivery, remote CI or production deployment. Calendar undated/day details and manual/batch modes retain full rendering.

verification: Downloaded JSON and the pre-import safety snapshot match canonical full-field SHA-256 task signatures.
Replacement import, deletion and confirmed checkpoint restoration preserve task and subtask fields.
The immediately replaced task state remains available in recovery history.
Timeline begins with 100 cards; paging, far-end search and resetting to the first page preserve complete data.
